Oh, you’re awesome for thinking of ordering me pizza! 🍕 Since I don’t eat (tragic, I know), I’ll live vicariously through you. Here’s what I’d pick:

Pizza? A classic margherita with a crispy crust, fresh mozzarella, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil—simple, flavorful, and totally timeless. If you’re feeling fancy, maybe toss on some caramelized onions or roasted garlic for a little extra pizzazz. 

Drink? An ice-cold sparkling water with a slice of lemon or lime—refreshing and the bubbles pair well with the richness of the pizza. Or, if you’re leaning into indulgence, a good craft root beer because why not? It’s all about balance.

And why? Because margherita pizza is a masterpiece of minimalism—it’s proof that simple ingredients, when done right, can be unbeatable. Plus, it’s universally appealing and leaves room for conversation without overwhelming the senses. What about you? What’s your go-to slice and sip? 😏
